description: The file is a JSON schema and API definition for the VoiceControl plugin, detailing methods, events, parameters, and data structures related to voice control sessions and server interactions.

methods.name: configureVoice
methods.description: Configures the RDK's voice stack with various URL schemes and device options.

methods.name: sendVoiceMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the Voice Server, such as context or ASR blobs.

methods.name: setVoiceInit
methods.description: Sets application metadata in the INIT message sent to the Voice Server.

methods.name: voiceSessionByText
methods.description: Simulates a voice session with transcription text for QA purposes, triggers session events.

methods.name: voiceSessionTypes
methods.description: Retrieves supported voice session request types.

methods.name: voiceSessionRequest
methods.description: Requests a voice session using specified request type and parameters.

methods.name: voiceSessionTerminate
methods.description: Terminates a voice session with the given session ID.

methods.name: voiceSessionAudioStreamStart
methods.description: Starts a subsequent audio stream for an ongoing voice session.

methods.name: voiceStatus
methods.description: Returns current status of the voice stack and URLs configured.
